title:
Comment of Dianna Odell in Docket(s)/Project(s) P-15424-000
Submission Date: 10/19/2026

documents.name: 151695.txt
documents.text:
Dianna Odell, Portsmouth, RI.
Do not put a Data Center in Maine's waters. Between the noise and the heat the center will give off it will kill marine life around it. There are threatened species in those waters that must be protected. The world does not need data centers every 10 feet. Thank you for your attention to this matter. No data centers in our waters.
